goal.question: Analyze monthly revenue by region and identify the top performing regions in Q1 2026.
goal.decision_context: Support a regional performance review for Q1 2026.
goal.success_criteria: Show which regions contribute the most revenue each month and overall in the quarter.

assumptions: Revenue is stored in the revenue column.

metrics.name: total_revenue
metrics.definition: Total revenue aggregated from order rows.

dimensions.label: Region
dimensions.reason: Revenue needs to be compared across regions.

comparisons.expected_signal: Identify which regions consistently lead revenue.

methods.name: aggregate_revenue_by_region_month
methods.description: Aggregate revenue by month and region for the Q1 window.

methods.name: rank_regions
methods.description: Rank regions by total revenue within each month and for the quarter overall.

metric_sanity_checks: Monthly totals should sum to the quarterly total.
coverage_checks: Schema contains time, geography, and revenue fields needed for the requested analysis.

output.title: Top regions by monthly revenue in Q1 2026
output.narrative_focus: Highlight which regions lead revenue and whether leadership changes month to month.
